newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Music ask-only on failure to resign pop group.
newsitem.headline: Sony Music ask-only on failure to resign pop group.

text.p: Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc's shares were ask-only on Monday morning, depressed by news that the firm had failed to renew a contract with Japanese pop group Dreams Come True, brokers said.
As of 0041 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 5,420 yen compared with the closing price of 5,620 on Friday.

Sony Music said in a statement on Friday that it and the group's music production company had failed to agree on a new contract. Dreams Come True has sold more than 22 million albums through the company since its debut in March 1989, a company spokesman said.
Both Nomura Securities Co Ltd's research arm and Nikko Research Center Ltd said on Monday they had downgraded Sony Music.
